scope: Recover P5 closure on exact M7-repaired head dd50af56 by carrying only the already proven world-regression baseline/test compatibility repairs and the bounded compact gameplay replica health-bookkeeping repair required by strict P2/P5 reconnect validation. Preserve canonical P5 equipment/mining semantics; do not expand product scope or create a second item/equipment/network/persistence truth.
required_outputs: One legally dispatched P5 closure carrier from exact dd50af56
Bounded compact replica health repair that clears only superseded MULTIPLAYER_SAME_REVISION_MUTATION after a later accepted authoritative compact update
Fresh exact-head Project Control, P5 focused, M7 and full 239-test world/core evidence
Fresh Evidence Map, independent Reviewer PASS and independent Verifier PASS before checkpoint proposal
stop_conditions: Any production path outside scripts/runtime/networked_gameplay/m3/m3_graphical_client_runtime.gd would require mutation
Any P5 canonical equipment/mining behavior would need redesign
Any network protocol, authority, persistence or reconciliation foundation change would be required
Any donor path outside the explicitly listed closure-carrier set would be required
A second autonomous runtime mutation worker would be required
Exact donor equivalence to the already tested fe051261 candidate cannot be proven
risk_reasons: Touches the active graphical multiplayer client composition boundary
Must distinguish a rejected same-revision mutation from later authoritative convergence without weakening rejection semantics

design_brief.problem_statement: P5 exact dd50 passes focused gates, but full-world closure requires inherited baseline/test compatibility repairs. Strict P2/P5 live validation additionally exposed stale client health bookkeeping after a correctly rejected same-revision compact mutation is superseded by a later accepted authoritative compact update.
design_brief.current_behavior: Prototype donor fe051261 passes strict P2 41/41, P5 focused 14/14, M7 63/63 and one continuous 239/239 + main_scene_cli_all run, but #156/#158 were created as repair prototypes without one Work Order whose allowed_paths covers the entire stacked delta.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Reproduce the exact proven donor blobs only after a fresh Director dispatch that explicitly owns all 25 changed paths, then revalidate exact-head and hand one legally scoped candidate to independent review.
alternatives_considered: Create a fresh dispatched closure carrier and port byte-identical donor blobs
design_brief.selected_design: Fresh repair/v0-p5-closure-r2 from exact dd50af56. First commit only the R2 epoch/Work Order/dispatch. Second commit ports exact fe051261 donor blobs for the 25 declared paths. No other source mutation is allowed.
design_brief.why_selected: It preserves fail-closed control semantics: authorization precedes production mutation, donor behavior is already deeply tested, and the final reviewer gets one exact combined target.
dependencies: prototype donor bb3e55a / fe051261 as non-authorizing evidence
non_goals: No acceptance or merge in implementer session
expected_risks: Full runner flake hides a real regression
Control carrier accidentally expands beyond 25 paths
validation_plan: Prove 25/25 changed production/test blobs equal fe051261 donor
Run strict P1/P2/P4 compatibility focused gates
Run one continuous 239/239 world/core plus main_scene_cli_all
Freeze Evidence Map and hand exact head to fresh Reviewer/Verifier

notes: PR #156 and #158 remain non-authorizing prototype donors. This R2 carrier exists specifically to ensure durable scope authorization precedes the one runtime mutation and the inherited test/control carrier. Do not merge or accept P5 from this Work Order without fresh independent review and verifier evidence.
